Jasmine / Aditya —

Reviewed the ask and the numbers in HubSpot (DL-2026-0743). Deal economics are attractive (ACV $1.1M first year, 18% expansion in year two). Finance is willing to consider Net-90 on a case-by-case basis given the strategic nature of Echolon, but we need the following controls before I can sign off:

- 25% invoice on contract execution (non-refundable)
- Quarterly invoices thereafter (3x equal installments after initial invoice)
- Contract clause tying payment schedule to license activation (service activation contingent on initial payment)
- Credit check completed and PO/confirmation from Echolon's AP
- Deal Desk will record an AR reserve in the month of booking to reflect timing risk

If those are acceptable, I can provisionally approve Net-90 subject to Legal redline acceptance of the payment schedule language and a managed rollback to Net-60 if AR metrics degrade during first 90 days.

Requesting final exec sign-off from Vivek (cc'd) for the exception.

Subject: APPROVED: Net-90 exception for Echolon Systems (conditional)

Team —

I've reviewed the ask and Marissa's proposed mitigants. Approve a conditional Net-90 for Echolon subject to these firm conditions:

1) 25% non-refundable initial payment at signing (invoice generated at contract execution)
2) Remaining balance split into three quarterly invoices (dates to be explicit in SOW)
3) Legal must add a payment schedule clause and a right-to-suspend services clause tied to missed payment of any installment
4) Customer must provide a valid PO and complete credit check; if credit check flags, term reverts to Net-30 or we require a LOC
5) Finance to book an AR reserve and monitor for the first 90 days; Deal Desk to reconvene after 60 days for health check

Jasmine — proceed to send the revised SOW with payment schedule and DocuSign link. Copy me and Marissa on the final DocuSign envelope. If the customer agrees to the 25% initial payment and PO, treat this as approved.
